name: 01844 · Methuen, MA
findings: ZIP 01844 (Methuen) has 123 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01844 (Methuen) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 01844 (Methuen) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.
